description: Landing page loads with CSS applied (no unstyled-HTML regression)
Login page reachable from landing page link
AuthenticationFilter blocks an unauthenticated request to a protected URL
Client-side required-field validation on login form (no request sent)
Server rejects a wrong password with a generic error (does not reveal which field was wrong)
Receptionist sees clinic-wide schedule + Register New Appointment action
Register form renders with dentist/treatment dropdowns populated from DB
Server-side validation rejects a fully blank submission even without browser required attrs
messageShown: Patient name, address and contact number are all required.

description: Contact number format validated against real Sri Lankan mobile pattern (07XXXXXXXX / +947XXXXXXXX)
messageShown: Contact number must be a valid Sri Lankan number, e.g. 0771234567 or +94771234567.

description: Past-dated appointments are rejected — cannot book into the past
messageShown: Appointment date cannot be in the past.

description: Availability check blocks a double-booking against an already-scheduled slot for the same dentist
messageShown: Dr. Dr. Amaya Silva is not available on 2026-09-06 at 10:00 — please choose a different slot.

description: A valid, non-clashing booking succeeds and redirects to Display Appointment Details (POST-redirect-GET)
Search-by-number finds and displays a pre-existing appointment
Search-by-number reports a clean not-found message for an unknown appointment number
Viewing the bill for an already-billed appointment returns the existing stored total (fn_bill_total-computed)
Requesting a bill for an unbilled appointment generates one (treatment cost + clinic consultation fee)
Manage-appointment lookup form renders with no appointment yet selected
Cancel action updates status to CANCELLED and records the change reason
Dentist-caused delay cascades automatically to every later appointment that day for the same dentist
Patient-caused delay with WAIT decision cascades the rest of the day, same as a dentist delay
messageShown: Patient delay recorded (waiting) — the rest of the dentist's day has shifted too.

description: Patient-caused delay with SKIP decision cancels the slot instead of cascading
messageShown: Patient skipped — appointment cancelled. Reschedule below once a new slot is agreed.

description: Reschedule moves an appointment to a new slot, re-validated with the same availability rules as a fresh booking
Booking sends a notification and is logged to the audit trail; a delay recorded on the same appointment does NOT (gap found during this test, not fixed)
Help page renders full step-by-step guide
Logout invalidates the session and returns to the login page
Administrator sees every nav item (Register/Search/Bill/Manage/Availability/Staff/Reports/Help)
Staff list shows all seeded accounts with role
Server-side validation enforces a minimum password length when adding staff
messageShown: Password must be at least 6 characters.

description: A valid new staff account is created and immediately listed
Removing a still-referenced staff account (a dentist with appointments) is safely rejected, not silently allowed or mislabeled
messageShown: Could not remove this account — it may still be referenced elsewhere (e.g. a dentist with existing appointments).

description: Staff removal works and is confirmed before submitting (JS confirm dialog)
Administrator sees a picker across all dentists (a Dentist skips straight to their own record)
Administrator can change any dentist's daily appointment limit

Reports page shows real aggregated figures from the database (including a stored-procedure call)
Dentist dashboard is scoped to their own schedule and hides Register/Search/Bill in the nav
RoleGuard blocks a Dentist from Register New Appointment even via a direct URL, not just a hidden nav link
RoleGuard blocks a Dentist from Calculate & Print Bill even via a direct URL
